origin: centre of the ground-floor square at ground level

containment.note: Roof, roots, branches, limbs, pipes and decorative attachments all count. Future animation and mechanical operating envelopes must also fit.

reference_visuals.base: solid ground-floor square, top surface at z=0; presentation plinth lies below ground and is not construction geometry
reference_visuals.spectral_outer_cube: translucent six-face enclosure from ground level to the size-specific height, with thin visible edges
reference_visuals.classification: engineering guides; intentionally simple primitives, not faction art candidates

runtime_integration: Authoring and exported-asset gate. Existing six-tile city parcels and host placement checks are not migrated by this standard. Continental macro parcels have no assumed metre conversion.
